reviews.title: Great for dog breath and teeth
reviews.body: My vet had recommended a dental chew for one of my two dogs, so I decided to go with this bone. Both of my dogs absolutely LOVE these dog treats/bones! The eat them as soon as they get them - without hesitation! As soon as I open the bag, the dogs hear the sound and come running. The bones have helped with my dogs' breath and mouth cleanliness, so I am pleased with the quality. I am pleased with the nutrition label and am convinced that the bones are healthy for my pups. I have been giving my dogs these treats/bones consistently for more than a year and plan to continue. They are effective and a great value. I recommend if you are looking for a treat that helps your dog's breath and teeth.

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Tail‑Wagging Dental Care My Dog Actually Loves
reviews.body: After a month of handing out Pedigree Dentastix Fresh to my 55‑pound Border Collie, I’m convinced these treats are the easiest way to keep a big dog’s mouth clean and breath-friendly. The large‑breed sticks are sturdy enough to make him work—he chews for a good two minutes instead of crushing them in a single bite—and that gnawing action scrubs away plaque along the gumline better than any toothbrush he’s ever tolerated. The fresh‑mint flavor leaves his kisses noticeably less dog‑breathy, which my family appreciates every time he hops on the couch for cuddles.I give him one stick after dinner, and he now trots to the pantry like clockwork, tail whirling because he actually thinks it’s dessert. The ridged design fits perfectly between his back molars, and my vet commented at his last check‑up that tartar buildup had dropped since our previous visit—no sedation cleanings on the horizon. The 36‑count, 1.87‑pound bag is resealable and sturdy, so the treats stay crisp instead of going rubbery, and the price per stick beats anything else with comparable dental benefits.Best of all, there’s zero stomach upset; the formula sits well even on his sensitive GI system, and the calorie count is low enough that I don’t have to trim back food portions. From fresher breath and cleaner teeth to that unmistakable tail‑thumping excitement, these Dentastix earn a solid five stars in our house. If you’ve got a big chewer who deserves healthy gums and minty‑fresh smooches, toss a bag in your cart—you’ll both be happier for it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 18 July 2025
reviews.author: CK

reviews.title: Dog Loves Them!
reviews.body: I’ve been giving Pedigree Dentastix to my large breed dog (a 60 lb golden doodle) for a few months now, and I’m really pleased with the results so far. He absolutely loves them — it’s the one “treat” that he consistently gets excited for, even more than biscuits or jerky. I give him one a day after dinner, and it’s become part of his routine.From what I can tell, the Dentastix do a decent job of freshening his breath. It’s not minty-fresh like a human mouth, but definitely an improvement from before. I’ve also noticed that the back teeth, where he chews the most, are looking a little cleaner and have less visible plaque. I wouldn’t expect miracles, but as part of a dental care routine, this is a solid addition.The sticks are firm enough to provide a bit of chewing resistance but not so hard that he gives up or swallows it whole. They’re the right size for big dogs, and they don’t crumble or make a mess. One box lasts about a month, which is reasonable for the price.I gave 4 stars instead of 5 only because I’d love to see even more noticeable results on his front teeth, and I wish the breath-freshening effect lasted a bit longer. But overall, this is a great product that does what it promises. I’ll definitely keep buying them.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 23 July 2025
reviews.author: Nixon
